title: The Boys Series Finale: Blood and Bone
original_title: The Boys Series Finale: Blood and Bone
overview: "Blood and Bone" is the eighth episode of the fifth season of The Boys and the series finale. It is set to release on May 20, 2026, on Amazon Prime Video. It is the fortieth and final episode overall.  Homelander controls America through fascist terror, imprisoning Starlighters in Freedom Camps. With everything on the line, Butcher, Hughie, Annie and the rest of The Boys must mount a diabolical last stand against insurmountable odds, in an attempt to stop Homelander's tyrannical rule. Scorched Earth. Shock and Awe. Blood and Bone.
